The press-documented workforce reductions at former Convergys sites (Erlanger, Southfield, Watertown, Tucson) all fall in the ~first year after the October 2018 close and thus predate the window, and the slice explicitly declines to substitute them as within-window outcome facts. With no sourced within-window disruption evidence at either interface, both pathways are coded uncertain per the no-record convention rather than 0.
